basic_details.short_information: Chhattisgarh Karmachari Chayan Mandal (CGSSB), formerly known as CG Vyapam, has started the online application process for Lecturer (Vyakhyata) posts in government schools of Chhattisgarh. The recruitment is being conducted for Lok Shiksha Sanchalanaya, Chhattisgarh (Directorate of Public Instruction) under two cadres: E Samvarg (E Cadre) and T Samvarg (T Cadre). Online applications are open from 29 September 2026 and the last date to apply is 26 October 2026 (till 5:00 PM). The written recruitment exam (LSL26) is scheduled tentatively for 29 November 2026

how_to_apply: Candidates can follow these steps to apply online for the CGSSB Lecturer posts:
Visit the official CGSSB website: vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or cgssb.cgstate.gov.in.

Complete the new profile registration. Keep a front-facing photograph on a light background in JPG/JPEG format (50 KB to 100 KB) and a scanned signature in a separate JPG/JPEG file (50 KB to 100 KB) ready. The file name should be alphanumeric without spaces or dots.
Read the "Instructions to fill the FORM" link on the website for the detailed application process.
Log in and select the Lecturer (Vyakhyata) recruitment and choose only one subject.
Check the details auto-filled from the profile and complete the application form.
Pay the application fee online as per your category.
Click the "SUBMIT" button after the fee payment and take a printout of the application form.
important_instructions: Complete the new profile registration on the CGSSB portal first. The online application uses the details saved in the profile, so check the profile carefully before submitting the application. Certificates such as caste, date of birth, local resident, educational qualification, disability and ex-serviceman are not collected with the online application. The appointing authority will verify them later, and the candidate is fully responsible for the information entered. Corrections in basic details must be made in the profile registration. The candidate has to make corrections on their own within the three-day window after the last date. The admit card and result will be issued on the basis of the details filled in the application. CGSSB will not make any correction at any stage. After successful fee payment, press the "SUBMIT" button. Take a printout of the online application and keep it safe. Candidates selected under a reserved category must produce a permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority. Married SC/ST women must submit a caste certificate showing the father's name along with their own name. Selected candidates in the PwD category will undergo a benchmark disability and functional requirement check by the District Medical Board before joining. Providing false information or using unfair means can lead to cancellation of candidature or selection, and the notification also provides for criminal prosecution in specified cases.

content_sections.heading: CG Vyapam Lecturer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must hold a postgraduate or equivalent degree in second class in one of the subjects below from a recognised university or institution, along with a B.Ed. degree. The educational qualifications will be treated as valid as per the notifications issued by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) from time to time and the court orders in force. The certificate proving the required educational qualification and other eligibility must be obtained on or before the last date of online application set by CGSSB. Dual, joint and double degrees are governed by the University Grants Commission letter D.O. No. F.1-6/2007 (CPP-II) dated 5 June 2025, as mentioned in the notification. The minimum age is 21 years (completed) and the candidate must not have completed 35 years of age as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxation is available as per the rules mentioned in the notification. After claiming relaxation under one or more of the above groups, the maximum age for entry into government service should not exceed 45 years. In any other case, the age limit is not relaxed. Departmental candidates need prior permission of the appointing authority to appear in the selection. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. The candidate must hold a Chhattisgarh local resident certificate. A candidate can apply for only one subject. Applications for more than one subject will be rejected. Candidates already working in a Chhattisgarh government department, corporation, board or undertaking, or in a central government undertaking, a nationalised or non-nationalised bank, a private institution or any university, must submit a No Objection Certificate from the appointing authority. A candidate who has more than one living spouse, or a woman candidate who has married a man with a living spouse, is not eligible for appointment, unless exempted by the government for special reasons. Selected candidates must be declared medically fit under the prescribed health examination, and their character verification (police verification) will be conducted. Fully blind candidates trained in Braille are considered suitable for teaching language, arts and commerce groups. Untrained fully blind candidates are not eligible for any subject. Candidates with hearing impairment are eligible only if they can hear with a hearing aid, and fully deaf candidates are not eligible.
